section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study (Study X) conducted in Vienna, Austria. The sample consisted of 156 women and 144 men (N=300) from the general population, with mean ages of 31.66 and 33.31 years respectively, and mean BMIs of 21.94 and 24.01 kg/m² respectively. The majority of participants were educated to secondary level (68%), with only 14.3% having university education.
